details:
Looking at the vast amount of the comments so far. I can see people are upset about EAC. 
We know it's been against TOS to have mods but the removal of mods is clearly damaging to those who need them for accessibility. 
I pitch that you hold off on adding EAC until you add the accessibility mods first. 
I can wait on QOL and Creators tools. Accessibility comes first.  
To talk sensibly for a moment, away from those screaming murder about mirrors and avatar searching. 
Those who do not need accessibility tools can play the game without mods but in your blogpost you mention about adding features "soon". You better introduce a lot of those mods into the base of VRC as quick as you're rolling out EAC from open beta or you're revealing that you do not care about accessibility.
The fact is, accessibility mods are CRUTIAL to people in this game.
Please delay this from being added into base game, do more testing in open beta, add the accessibility tools first, then add EAC if you must.
I don't know why you are adding EAC so quickly and with a very MINIMAL beta period, if there is something you are planning that is beneficial. Use your community managers to communicate what your roadmap really looks like. But the key thing here is: Accessibility first.
Fix that.
title: Add Accessibility Tools before EAC
